label: platform sweep
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: On the home page the Add to Cart buttons in the Hot Sellers grid could not be clicked because the product grid list was covering them; I had to open the product page instead.

Right after the product page opened, the Add to Cart button was shown as disabled and the page lacked its tabs and gallery; I had to read again before the button became usable, with no message about loading.
The checkout page first showed only a Loading image with no form; I had to read again to see the form, and the loading state was announced only as an unlabelled image.

The Email Address field has a Tooltip button with no meaningful name (just the word Tooltip), and the same for the phone number Tooltip, so the purpose of these buttons is unclear. Also many fields show labels as plain text beside the textbox with the asterisk in the name.
After choosing the state, city, or ZIP, the shipping method radios became disabled and a Loading image appeared without any announcement, so I could not tell when I could pick a shipping method.
After clicking Next the page showed only a Loading image and the old shipping form for a step; the move to the payment step was not announced and I had to read again to find the payment form.

findings.problem: On the home page the Add to Cart buttons in the Hot Sellers grid could not be clicked because the product grid list was covering them; I had to open the product page instead.

Right after the product page opened, the Add to Cart button was shown as disabled and the page lacked its tabs and gallery; I had to read again before the button became usable, with no message about loading.
The checkout page first showed only a Loading image with no form; I had to read again to see the form, and the loading state was announced only as an unlabelled image.

The Email Address field has a Tooltip button with no meaningful name (just the word Tooltip), and the same for the phone number Tooltip, so the purpose of these buttons is unclear. Also many fields show labels as plain text beside the textbox with the asterisk in the name.
After choosing the state, city, or ZIP, the shipping method radios became disabled and a Loading image appeared without any announcement, so I could not tell when I could pick a shipping method.
After clicking Next the page showed only a Loading image and the old shipping form for a step; the move to the payment step was not announced and I had to read again to find the payment form.
